name: Client discovery catalog and special requests

truthOwner: DSH central catalog store marketing and special-request domains

tasks.requiredChange: Trace publication, assortment, inventory/pricing/media into projection/readback and remove duplicate local visibility rules.
tasks.targetState: One server-owned projection determines client visibility.
tasks.action: Test negative/transition publication cases and fix first divergent owner.

tasks.currentProblem: Valid content can target stale or unauthorized destinations.
tasks.requiredChange: Bind actions to canonical published entities and fail closed on retired targets.
tasks.targetState: Marketing is presentation over current canonical entities only.
tasks.action: Census actions and remove stale destination adapters.

tasks.objective: Close sovereign special-request idempotency and serviceability.
